cbuildbot: Use the same image as moblab and sub-DUT in VM test. MoblabVMTsetStage requires two VMs -- the moblab VM and the DUT attached to it. So far, we had a golden version hard-coded for the sub-DUT image. This has two issues: - After a while, the golden version needs to be bumped as the archived images are deleted. - Any changes to the suites used by moblab_RunSuite would not reflect in the build being tested because they come from the target build for the sub-DUT. By using the current build for both DUTs, we make sure that all the software involved in the test is at the version under test. BUG=chromium:725620 TEST=moblab vm test. Change-Id: I580fdd2a22ca7120a1e5629bbd2a8fb321e674ad Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/815941 Commit-Ready: Prathmesh Prabhu <pprabhu@chromium.org> Tested-by: Prathmesh Prabhu <pprabhu@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Aviv Keshet <akeshet@chromium.org>

Add a minimal server side test suite excluding SSP. We do not support SSP in moblab-generic-vm yet. The minimal dummy_server suite runs dummy_PassServer thrice -- with SSP, without SSP and maybe with SSP. This is wasteful in the case when we don't support SSP at all. So create an even simpler suite with just the nossp version of the test. We still want to run it via a suite, so that we test the dynamic_suites logic. BUG=chromium:793016 TEST=moblab-vm-tests.
